newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CZECHS OUT OF WORLD CUP AFTER 1-0 DEFEAT BY SPAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CZECHS OUT OF WORLD CUP AFTER 1-0 DEFEAT BY SPAIN.

text.p: The Czech Republic, beaten European championship finalists last year, were left without any chance of reaching next year's World Cup finals when they lost 1-0 to Spain on Sunday.
The result left Spain one point clear of Yugoslavia in European group six, dramatically increasing their chances of qualifying either as group winners or best-placed second team.
Fernando Hierro scored the only goal just before halftime from the penalty spot after Alfonso Perez was brought down by Czech goalkeeper Pavel Srnicek.
The Czechs had dominated the game until then after taking advantage of problems in the Spanish defence caused by the absence through injury of left-back Sergi Barjuan.
